description: JASDF free-loan airframe; struck off 16 Jun 1980 and on display here since about June 1982; the radio call 46-8568 is just readable through the clouded canopy; painted overall silver in about 2005 and repainted again in Aug 2022 restoring the anti-glare panel and the light blue radome. A maintainer's farewell message misspelling the serial as 46-9568 was painted out in 2005 and reinstated in a modified form in 2015
